sample.q: Why did you choose that subject or job?
sample.a: Well, I've always been fascinated by how things work, so engineering felt like a natural choice. To be honest, my parents also encouraged me, because they thought it would offer good career prospects. But now that I'm in my second year, I can genuinely say it was the right decision. I particularly enjoy the practical projects, where we actually build something rather than just reading about it.

sample.q: Has your hometown changed much in recent years?
sample.a: Yes, quite dramatically, actually. When I was a child, it was a fairly quiet town surrounded by farmland, but over the last ten years a lot of new apartment blocks and shopping centres have been built. On the positive side, there are far more facilities now, like a new hospital and a cinema. The downside, though, is that the traffic has become a real problem, and some of the green spaces I used to play in have disappeared.
